clause: Liquid layout rules + Adjust Layout command [STU-LAY-009,STU-LAY-010]

scope.summary: Implement responsive layout adaptation when page size/orientation/margins/bleed change via two coexisting mechanisms. Per-page liquid rules applied continuously, enumerable and normative: Off (absolute geometry), Scale (proportional scale preserving relative positions), Re-center (keep size, re-center), Object-based (per-object edge pins + resize constraints for mixed fixed/relative), Guide-based (liquid guides slice the page; crossed objects stretch while text reflows and images resize without distortion), Controlled-by-Parent (inherit the parent page's liquid rule). Adjust Layout is a discrete undoable command that recomputes object positions/sizes on geometry change with options: adjust font size (min/max limit), include locked content, move ruler guides. Solved via LayoutEngine constraint solver.
acceptance_criteria: all six liquid rules + discrete undoable Adjust Layout with font/locked/guide options
proof_targets: six-rule adaptation runtime; Adjust Layout discrete-undoable test
expected_tests: live: each of the six liquid rules adapts a resized page as specified (guide-based reflows text, resizes images undistorted)
test: Adjust Layout recomputes positions/sizes with font min/max + locked + guide-move options; discrete + undoable

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Liquid layout & Adjust Layout

risk_if_missed: Resizing pages breaks layouts; no responsive adaptation; manual rework on every geometry change.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.

minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
